title: Adversary bounds and the polynomial method for quantum queries
abstract: Develops finite quantum query algorithms, real adversary primal and dual programs, strong duality, exact Boolean block composition, explicit constant-factor bounded-error query characterizations, and degree bounds for output-probability polynomials. Query models include idle and blank sectors; bounds count queries, not gate complexity or running time. Uniform algorithm extraction assumes a supplied dual certificate.

informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.advDual_eq_advPM: For every total Boolean function on a finite Boolean input cube, the all-pairs real adversary dual infimum equals the real symmetric primal supremum.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.advPM_composeFun_: The negative-weight adversary value of total Boolean functions composed on disjoint blocks equals the product of their adversary values, including constant functions and empty index types.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.boundedErrorQQuer: For a total Boolean function at error one third, quantum value-query complexity lies between ADV±/36 and 2^14 ADV±. The value oracle swaps a blank answer with the queried letter and includes an idle query index.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.xorQQuery_charact: For the Boolean XOR oracle with idle and blank sectors, query complexity at error one third lies between ADV±/72 and 2^15 ADV±.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.qQueryOn_third_le: A supplied all-pairs real dual certificate of nonnegative cost c gives a finite quantum algorithm using at most 8192(1+c) value queries at error one third, for any finite promise domain and nonempty decidable output type.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.QAlg.exists_proba: Each output probability of a q-query value-oracle algorithm on Boolean inputs agrees on the Boolean cube with a real polynomial of total degree at most 2q.
informal.QuantumQueryComplexity.exists_xor_probab: Each output probability of a q-query Boolean XOR algorithm agrees on the Boolean cube with a real polynomial of total degree at most 2q.
